title: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
english: Christa Pike, a death row inmate in Tennessee, has regained consciousness and is speaking following a failed lethal injection attempt. Legal and medical experts describe her survival as an unprecedented event, as she is the first person to recover after the successful administration of execution chemicals. The state has suspended all executions for the remainder of the year while the prison commissioner has announced his resignation following the incident.
amharic: በቴነሲ ግዛት የሞት ፍርድ ተፈርዶባት የነበረችው ክሪስታ ፓይክ፣ የተፈፀመባት ገዳይ መርፌ ሳይሳካ ቀርቶ በህይወት መትረፏ ተሰምቷል። አሁን ንቃተ ህሊናዋን መልሳ ማውራት የጀመረችው ይህች እስረኛ፣ ገዳይ መርዝ ከተወጋላት በኋላ በህይወት የተረፈች የመጀመሪያዋ ሰው እንደሆነች ባለሙያዎች ገልጸዋል። ይህ ያልተለመደ ክስተት ተከትሎ፣ የቴነሲ ግዛት አስተዳደር በዚህ አመት የታቀዱ የሞት ፍርድ አፈፃፀሞችን ያገደ ሲሆን፣ የክልሉ የእስር ቤቶች ሃላፊም ከስልጣናቸው እንደሚለቁ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hiriibaa du'aa kan murteeffamte Christa Pike, guyyaa murtiin du'aa itti raawwatame keemikaalli du'aa ishee keessa galus lubbuun hafuun ishee dinqisiisaa ta'eera. Ogeeyyoonni yaalaa fi seeraa akka jedhanitti, namni yeroo keemikaalli ajjeesu qaama isaa keessa galu fayye hin jiru, kanaafuu kun seenaa keessatti kan jalqabaati. Mudannoo kanaan walqabatee mootummaan naannoo Tennessee raawwii adabbii du'aa waggaa kanaaf guyyoota hafan hunda dhaabuu isaa fi itti gaafatamaan mana hidhaa naannichaa hojii gadhiisuu isaa beekameera.

title: A beautiful Himalayan bird is changing its voice due to human activity, research shows
english: Researchers in India have discovered that the Himalayan monal pheasant is being forced to change its natural song to communicate over increasing human noise. Additionally, expanding tourism and construction are pushing these birds to higher altitudes as their original habitats become overcrowded. These behavioral and habitat shifts serve as a concerning indicator of how human activity is destabilizing the fragile ecosystem of the Himalayas.
amharic: በህንድ የሚገኙ ተመራማሪዎች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የሂማላያ የሞናል ወፎች በሰው ሰራሽ ጫጫታ ምክንያት የመግባቢያ ድምፃቸውን ለመቀየር ተገደዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በቱሪዝም እና በግንባታ ስራዎች መጨመር ምክንያት ወፎቹ ወደ ተራራው ከፍተኛ ቦታዎች እንዲሸሹ ተደርገዋል። ይህ የባህሪ እና የመኖሪያ ቦታ ለውጥ በሂማላያ ስስ ስነ-ምህዳር ላይ የሰዎች እንቅስቃሴ እያሳደረ ያለውን አሉታዊ ተፅእኖ ያሳያል።
oromo: Qorattoonni Indiyaa keessatti argaman akka hubatanitti, simbirroon 'monal' jedhamtu kan Himalaya keessa jiraattu, sagalee namootaan uumamu mo'achuuf jecha sagalee ishee jijjiirrachuuf dirqamteetti. Kana malees, babal'achuu turistii fi ijaarsawwan garaagaraa simbirroowwan kun akka iddoo isaanii gadhiisanii gara gaara olka'aatti baqatan godheera. Jijjiirramni amalaa fi iddoo jireenyaa kun miidhaa hojiin namootaa uumama Himalaya irratti geessisaa jiru kan agarsiisu dha.

title: ‘We are desperate’: Venezuela’s power cuts fuel growing public anger
english: Venezuela is experiencing severe and frequent power outages that have disrupted daily life and essential healthcare services. Citizens are increasingly frustrated by these persistent blackouts, leading to widespread public protests against the government's management of the situation. Many people are questioning how such a resource-rich nation has fallen into a state of total energy instability, leaving residents without basic relief or reliable services.
amharic: ቬኔዙዌላ ከፍተኛ እና ተደጋጋሚ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እያጋጠማት ሲሆን ይህም የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮንና የጤና አገልግሎቶችን በእጅጉ እየጎዳ ይገኛል። እነዚህን ችግሮች መቋቋም ያቃታቸው ዜጎች በመንግስት ላይ ያላቸውን ተቃውሞ በመግለጽ ጎዳና ላይ በመውጣት ድምፃቸውን እያሰሙ ነው። ሀገሪቱ በሃብት የበለፀገች ብትሆንም በሃይል አቅርቦት እጦት ውስጥ መውደቋ ህዝቡን ክፉኛ እያበሳጨና አሳሳቢ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ጥሎታል።
oromo: Veenezueelaa keessatti rakkoon humna ibsaa cimaan guyyuu mudachaa jiraachuun isaa jireenya hawaasaa fi tajaajila fayyaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera. Hawaasni rakkoo kana to’achuu kan hin dandeenye mootummaa irratti mormii guddaa dhageessisaa jira. Biyyattiin qabeenya uumamaa hedduu kan qabdu ta’us, hanqina ibsaa kanaan rakkoo keessa galuun ishee lammiilee hedduu aarsaa fi yaaddoo keessa galcheera.

title: Christa Pike lawyers say she is speaking one week after failed execution
english: Christa Pike has regained consciousness and begun speaking nearly a week after a failed lethal injection attempt by the state of Tennessee. Although she is receiving medical care for severe injuries to her arms, she remains shackled in her hospital bed. This rare survival case has reignited significant public debate regarding the ethics and reliability of the death penalty in the United States.
amharic: ክሪስታ ፓይክ በቴነሲ ግዛት በተፈጸመባት ያልተሳካ የሞት ፍርድ አፈጻጸም ከአንድ ሳምንት በኋላ ንቃተ ህሊናዋን መልሳ ማውራት ጀምራለች። በእጆቿ ላይ የደረሰባትን ከባድ ጉዳት በሆስፒታል እየታከመች ቢሆንም፣ በሆስፒታል አልጋ ላይ በሰንሰለት ታስራ እንደምትገኝ ጠበቆቿ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ያልተለመደ ክስተት በአሜሪካ የሞት ፍርድ አሰጣጥ ሥርዓት ላይ ከፍተኛ ክርክር አስነስቷል።
oromo: Krista Paayik mootummaa Tenesii biratti adaba du'aa ishee irratti raawwatamuun osoo hin milkaa'in hafe torban tokko booda, fayyitee dubbachuu jalqabdeetti. Miidhaa harka ishee irratti irra ga'een walqabatee hospitaala keessatti gargaarsa fayyaa kan argachaa jirtu yoo ta'u, amma iyyuu siree ishee irra hidhamtee akka jirtu abukaatonni ishee ibsaniiru. Namni tokko adaba akkanaa keessa ooluun isaa biyyattii keessatti adeemsa adaba du'aa irratti falmii guddaa kaasuu danda'eera.

title: Fans flood Buenos Aires ahead of Messi’s final international match
english: Thousands of supporters have gathered at the Monumental stadium in Buenos Aires to witness Lionel Messi's last international appearance. The legendary captain and record-breaking scorer is retiring from national team duties after 21 years of service. He believes it is now the right moment to pass the torch to the next generation of Argentine players.
amharic: የሊዮኔል ሜሲን የመጨረሻ የአለም አቀፍ ጨዋታ ለመታደም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ደጋፊዎች በቦነስ አይረስ በሚገኘው ሞኑሜንታል ስታዲየም ተገኝተዋል። የዓለም ዋንጫ አሸናፊው እና የአርጀንቲና የምንግዜም ከፍተኛ ግብ አስቆጣሪ ለ21 ዓመታት የዘለቀውን የብሔራዊ ቡድን ቆይታውን በይፋ ሊያጠናቅቅ ነው። አሁን ለቀጣዩ ትውልድ ቦታ ለመልቀቅ ትክክለኛው ጊዜ እንደደረሰ ተጫዋቹ ገልጿል።
oromo: Deeggartootni kumaatamaan lakkaa’aman tapha Liionel Meesii kan biyyoolessa isa dhumaa ilaaluuf buufata istaadiyeemii Monumantaal kan Bu'eenoos Ayiresitti argamu guutaniiru. Kabajamaan fi kabajamaa taphataa biyya Arjantiinaa kan ta'e Meesiin, waggaa 21 booda taphuma isa dhumaa booda biyyoolessaaf taphachuu dhaabuuf murteesseera. Innis yeroon kun dhaloota haaraaf iddoo gadhiisuuf kan ga'e ta'uu dubbateera.

title: Houthis, Saudi-led forces claim victories as Yemen fighting rages on
english: Fighting has intensified in Yemen as both Houthi rebels and Saudi-led coalition forces report gains in the ongoing conflict. Houthi militants recently targeted airports in Saudi Arabia, while the coalition retaliated with airstrikes and asserted that they have secured control over the Bab al-Mandeb strait. Despite these counterclaims, the Houthi leadership insists they still hold their previously captured territories.
amharic: በየመን እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት የሁቲ አማጽያን እና የሳዑዲ ጥምረት ኃይሎች በየፊናቸው ድል እንደተቀዳጁ በመግለጽ ውጊያው ተባብሷል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የአየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ ጥቃት የሰነዘሩ ሲሆን፣ ጥምረት ኃይሉም በአየር ድብደባ ምላሽ ከመስጠቱ ባለፈ የባብ አል-ማንደብ ወሽመጥን መቆጣጠራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሁቲ አመራሮች በበኩላቸው ቀደም ሲል የተቆጣጠሯቸውን ቦታዎች አሁንም በቁጥጥራቸው ስር እንዳሉ ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Gonkoota Yemenitti walitti bu'iinsi hammaataa dhufeen, gareen Huthitii fi waraanni Sa'uudii hogganamu hundi injifannoo argachuu isaanii ibsachaa jiru. Huthitiin buufataalee xiyyaaraa Sa'uudii irratti haleellaa kan raawwatan yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin waraanni gamtaa sun haleellaa qilleensaatiin deebii kennanii fi daandii galaana Bab al-Mandeb toannoo isaanii jala galchuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, hogganoonni Huthitiin lafa kanaan dura qabatanii turan ammas guutummaatti toannoo isaanii jala jiraachuu isaa jabeessanii dubbatu.

title: Harry Kane equals England record, scores twice in 3-0 win over Czechia
english: Harry Kane celebrated his 125th appearance for England by scoring two goals in a 3-0 victory against Czechia in the UEFA Nations League. With this milestone, he equaled Peter Shilton’s record for the most appearances by a male player for the national team. England controlled the match throughout, starting with an own goal from a Czech defender followed by Kane's clinical finishes.
amharic: ሃሪ ኬይን ለእንግሊዝ ብሄራዊ ቡድን በ125ኛ ጨዋታው ላይ በመሰለፍ ሪከርዱን የደገመ ሲሆን በዩኤፋ ኔሽንስ ሊግ ከቼክ ሪፐብሊክ ጋር በተደረገው ጨዋታ ሁለት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር ቡድኑን 3-0 በሆነ ውጤት እንዲያሸንፍ አስችሏል። በዚህ ጨዋታ ኬይን ከዚህ ቀደም በፒተር ሺልተን ተይዞ የነበረውን የእንግሊዝ የወንዶች ብሄራዊ ቡድን የብዛት ጨዋታ ሪከርድ እኩል አድርጓል። እንግሊዝ በመጀመሪያ በቼክ ተከላካይ በተቆጠረ የራሱ ግብ መሪነትን የወሰደች ሲሆን ኬይን ባስቆጠራቸው ሁለት ተጨማሪ ግቦች ድሏን አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Haarii Keeniin tapha isaa 125ffaa garee biyyaalessaa Ingilizii irratti hirmaachuun riikardii biyyattii qixxeessera. Tapha UEFA Nations League kan ta'e kana irratti, Keeniin goolii lama lakkoofsisee gareen isaa Czechia 3-0 akka injifatu taasiseera. Kunis riikardii Piiyter Shiiltiin qabatee ture waliin kan qixxaatudha. Ingilizoonni taphicha haala gaariin hooggananii, goolii ofitti galchuun duraan booda gooliiwwan Keeniin lakkoofsise kanaan injifannoo argataniiru.

title: Two blasts reported nearby Aden International Airport
english: Two significant explosions have occurred in the vicinity of Aden International Airport in southern Yemen. Authorities and media outlets have confirmed the incident near the port city's facility. No further details regarding potential casualties or the cause of the blasts have been provided at this time.
amharic: በደቡባዊ የመን ከተማ ኤደን በሚገኘው ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ አቅራቢያ ሁለት ከፍተኛ የቦምብ ፍንዳታዎች ተሰምተዋል። መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት ፍንዳታዎቹ በአውሮፕላን ማረፊያው አካባቢ የተከሰቱ ቢሆንም፣ የደረሰው ጉዳት ወይም ፍንዳታው በምን ምክንያት እንደተከሰተ እስካሁን በግልጽ የታወቀ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Magaalaa Adeniitti kan argamu buufata xiyyaraa idil-addunyaa biratti dhoo'insi guddaan lama mudateera. Gabaasni miidiyaalee akka ibsetti, dhoo'insi kun naannoo buufata xiyyaraa keessatti kan ta'e yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti sababaa dhoo'insichaa fi miidhaa gahuu danda'e irratti odeeffannoon dabalataa hin kennamne.

title: Abdul El-Sayed is under fire for joining forces with Obama in upcoming rally
english: US Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is facing criticism for his plan to campaign alongside former President Barack Obama at a rally in Detroit. This event is scheduled for October 24 to help launch early voting for the Michigan Democratic ticket ahead of the November midterm elections. El-Sayed has previously faced backlash from progressive voters for his recent associations with prominent party figures like Kamala Harris.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴኔት እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ በዲትሮይት ከቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ባራክ ኦባማ ጋር በቅስቀሳ ላይ ለመሳተፍ በማቀዳቸው ትችት እየቀረበባቸው ነው። ይህ ዝግጅት በጥቅምት 24 ቀን የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ በኖቬምበር በሚካሄደው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ እጩዎችን ድጋፍ ለማሰባሰብ ያለመ ነው። ኤል-ሰይድ ከዚህ ቀደም ከካማላ ሃሪስ ጋር በመታየታቸው በፓርቲው ውስጥ ባሉ አንዳንድ ወገኖች ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸው ነበር።
oromo: Hirmaataan filannoo Senetii Ameerikaa Abdul El-Sayed magaalaa Detroititti pirezidantii duraanii Baraak Obaamaa waliin kampenii gochuuf karoorfachuu isaaniitiin qeeqa keessa galaniiru. title: The Error in Tsmido’s Trial and Error
english: Various Ethiopian opposition groups, including the TPLF, Fano, and the OLA, are exploring a tactical alliance aimed at weakening Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. While these groups share a common adversary, they lack a unified vision for Ethiopia's future and remain deeply divided on critical issues like federalism and territorial integrity. Analysts warn that this strategy is dangerous because if the government collapses, the lack of a shared post-Abiy plan could lead to state fragmentation or renewed internal conflict.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ተቃዋሚ ኃይሎች የሆኑት ህወሓት፣ ፋኖ እና የኦሮሞ ነጻነት ጦር የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አቢይ አህመድን መንግስት ለማዳከም በጋራ ለመስራት እየተወያዩ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ቡድኖች አንድ የጋራ ጠላት ቢኖራቸውም፣ ስለ ሀገሪቱ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ እና ስለ ስርአተ መንግስት ያላቸው አመለካከት እጅግ የተራራቀ ነው። መንግስት ቢዳከም ወይም ቢወድቅ ተከታዩን እርምጃ በተመለከተ ግልጽ እቅድ አለመኖሩ፣ ሀገሪቱን ወደ መበታተን ወይም ወደ ከፋ ግጭት ሊመራት እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Humnooni mormituu Itoophiyaa kan akka TPLF, Fano fi WBO mootummaa Abiy Ahimad laaffisuuf walitti dhufeenya uumaa jiru. Yoo mootummaan laaffate ykn kufe booda maal akka ta'u karoorri ifa ta'e waan hin jirreef, kun biyyattii gara diigamuu ykn walitti bu'iinsa caalaa fiduu danda'a jechuun xiinxaltoonni akeekkachiisu.

title: #ትሰማ Unmasks a Power Struggle Over Culture in Ethiopia
english: The Ethiopian #ትሰማ (Let Her Be Heard) campaign advocates for systemic reform in how authorities handle violence against women and girls. Supporters argue that current legal and institutional responses are inadequate and call for urgent national action to ensure justice and accountability. While the movement has gained significant traction online, it has also sparked a complex cultural debate regarding the influence of global values on traditional Ethiopian social structures.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያው #ትሰማ ንቅናቄ በሴቶችና በህፃናት ላይ የሚፈጸም ጥቃትን ለመከላከልና ተገቢውን የህግ ከለላ ለማስፈን እየሰራ ይገኛል። ንቅናቄው ነባር የፍትህ ስርዓቶች ክፍተት እንዳለባቸው በመግለጽ መንግስት ለችግሩ ትኩረት እንዲሰጥና ተጠያቂነትን እንዲያሰፍን ይወተውታል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ይህ እንቅስቃሴ የሚያመጣቸው ማህበራዊና ባህላዊ ለውጦች ከኢትዮጵያ እሴቶች ጋር እንዴት መጣጣም እንዳለባቸው በተመለከተ የተለያዩ ክርክሮች እየተነሱ ነው።
oromo: Duulli #ትሰማ jedhamu kun rakkoo gudeeddaa fi miidhaa dubartoota irratti raawwatamu ittisuuf akkasumas haqni akka argamuuf mootummaa fi qaamolee dhimmi ilaallatu gaafachaa jira. Duullichaa rakkoon kun haala itti fufiinsa qabuun akka ilaalamu fi seerri irratti akka ba’u fedha. Haa ta’u malee, sosochiin kun jijjiirama amala hawaasummaa fi aadaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu danda’a jechuun qaamolee tokko tokko biratti mormii fi yaada wal-dhabdee kaasaa jira.

title: Tear gas in Paris and Marseille as school protests grow across France
english: Widespread protests led by high school students have spread across France, drawing in university students and labor unions to demand better school conditions and less police interference. Authorities deployed tear gas and water cannons to disperse crowds in several major cities as demonstrators blockaded hundreds of institutions. While the government claims the unrest is being fueled by political opponents, students insist they are fighting against crumbling infrastructure and insufficient educational resources.

title: Is there a MAGA after Trump?
english: This discussion examines whether the MAGA political movement can survive without Donald Trump as its leader. Guests Rina Shah and Emma Doyle explore the central role Trump plays in defining the movement's identity. Ultimately, they question if MAGA is an independent political ideology or if it is inseparable from Trump himself.
amharic: ይህ ውይይት የ«ማጋ» (MAGA) የፖለቲካ እንቅስቃሴ ያለ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ መሪነት ሊቀጥል ስለመቻሉ ይቃኛል። እንግዶቹ ሪና ሻህ እና ኤማ ዶይል ትራምፕ የእንቅስቃሴውን ማንነት በመወሰን ረገድ ያላቸውን ትልቅ ድርሻ ይተነትናሉ። በመጨረሻም፣ «ማጋ» ራሱን የቻለ የፖለቲካ አስተሳሰብ ነው ወይስ ከትራምፕ የማይነጣጠል ጉዳይ ነው የሚለውን ጥያቄ ያነሳሉ።
oromo: Mariin kun sochii siyaasaa MAGA jedhamu kun hogganaa isaa Donald Trump malee itti fufuu danda'a moo hin danda'u kan jedhu irratti xiyyeeffata. Keessummoonni marii kanaa Rina Shah fi Emma Doyle, gahee guddaa Trump sochii kana ijaaruu irratti qaban xiinxalu. Dhuma irratti, MAGA sochii siyaasaa of danda'e dha moo fiixee Trump irratti kan hundaa'e dha kan jedhu irratti mari'atu.

title: Ronaldo apologizes for Portugal walkout; says Jesus broke promise
english: Cristiano Ronaldo has apologized for leaving the Portugal national team camp after a dispute with coach Jorge Jesus. The star player claims the coach repeatedly broke promises regarding playing time and a planned public explanation of their disagreement. While Ronaldo admits his decision to leave was unprofessional, he remains open to playing for his country again in the future.

title: Yemen’s government is on the attack against the Houthis. What has changed?
english: The Yemeni government has launched a new military offensive, dubbed Operation Dawn of Yemen, to reclaim territory from Houthi rebels, including the capital city of Sanaa. Supported by Saudi Arabian air power, these efforts aim to reverse recent Houthi gains near the strategic Bab al-Mandeb Strait. While previous government attempts were hampered by poor coordination and internal issues, this new campaign appears to be more organized as forces attempt to regain control of the region.
amharic: የየመን መንግስት የሁቲ አማፂያንን ለመዋጋት እና እንደ ዋና ከተማዋ ሰንዓ ያሉ ቦታዎችን መልሶ ለመቆጣጠር 'የየመን ንጋት' የተሰኘ አዲስ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ጀምሯል። የሳዑዲ አረቢያ የአየር ድጋፍ የታከለበት ይህ ዘመቻ፣ አማፂያኑ በቅርቡ በባብ አል-ማንደብ የባህር በር አካባቢ ያገኙትን ጥቅም ለመቀልበስ ያለመ ነው። ከዚህ ቀደም የነበሩ ወታደራዊ ጥረቶች በአደረጃጀት ጉድለት ተስተጓጉለው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ አሁን ያለው ጥቃት ይበልጥ የተቀናጀ መሆኑን መረጃዎች ይጠቁማሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen, magaalaa guddittii Sana’aa dabalatee lafa harka finxaaleyyii Huutii jiru deebisanii to’achuuf 'Bariin Yemen' kan jedhamu duula waraanaa haaraa jalqabeera. Kanaan dura rakkoo qindoominaa fi haala waraanaatiin kan gufatan ta’us, duulli kun kan duraa irra caalaatti gurmaa’inaan gaggeeffamaa akka jiru ibsameera.

title: Abdul El-Sayed is under fire for joining forces with Obama in upcoming rally
english: US Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is facing significant backlash after announcing that former President Barack Obama will join him at an upcoming campaign rally in Detroit. Critics are condemning the partnership due to Obama's record on drone warfare and his administration's history regarding Middle Eastern conflicts. This controversy follows recent criticism El-Sayed received for campaigning alongside Kamala Harris, as progressive voters continue to express frustration over mainstream Democratic ties to foreign military policies.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴኔት እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሳይድ፣ የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ባራክ ኦባማ በዲትሮይት በሚደረግ የምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ላይ እንደሚሳተፉ ማስታወቃቸውን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ትችት እየደረሰባቸው ነው። ተቺዎች ኦባማ በስልጣን ላይ በነበሩበት ወቅት በወሰዱት የድሮን ጥቃት እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ግጭቶች ላይ በነበራቸው ሚና ምክንያት ይህንን ህብረት አውግዘዋል። ኤል-ሳይድ ከዚህ ቀደም ከካማላ ሃሪስ ጋር በመሆን በምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ላይ በመታየታቸው ትችት የገጠማቸው ሲሆን፣ አሁን ደግሞ በዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ዋና መስመር ፖለቲከኞች እና በውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲዎች መካከል ባለው ግንኙነት ተስፋ የቆረጡ ደጋፊዎች ተቃውሟቸውን እያሰሙ ነው።
oromo: Hirmaataan filannoo Senetii Ameerikaa Abdul El-Sayed, pirezidaantii duraanii Baraak Oobamaa duula filannoo Detrooyit keessatti gaggeeffamu irratti akka hirmaatan beeksisuu isaa hordofee mormiin cimaan isa mudatee jira. Mormitoonni Oobamaa yeroo aangoo isaanii keessatti duula diroonii gaggeessuufi walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota giddu-galeessa bahaa keessatti gahee qabaachuu isaanii yaadachiisuun tarkaanfii kana balaaleffataniiru. El-Sayed kanaan dura Kaamalaa Haariis waliin duula filannoo irratti argamuu isaatiin mormiin irra gahee kan ture yoo ta'u, amma ammoo deggertoonni ejjennoo cimaa qaban hariiroo paartiin Deemokraatikaa fi siyaasa alaa gidduu jiru irratti mormii isaanii ibsachaa jiru.

title: Trump says ‘millions of barrels’ of oil transited through Hormuz
english: Former President Donald Trump stated that oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz have recovered to levels equal to or higher than those seen before the current conflict. He also claimed that Iran's oil minister resigned after admitting that the country's economy and oil industry have collapsed. These comments suggest an emphasis on the success of international transit efforts despite regional instability.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ጥብብ የሚተላለፈው የነዳጅ መጠን ከጦርነቱ በፊት ወደ ነበረበት ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ማደጉን ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም የኢራን የነዳጅ ሚኒስትር የአገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ እና የነዳጅ ዘርፍ መፈራረሱን በመግለጽ ከስልጣናቸው መልቀቃቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ አስተያየት በክልሉ ውስጥ ውጥረት ቢኖርም የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣው ስኬታማ መሆኑን ለማሳየት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, gabaan boba’aa karaa galaana Ormuz darbu sadarkaa waraana dura ture irra gahuu ykn caaluu danda’eera. Kana malees, ministeerri boba’aa Iraan dinagdeen biyyattii fi indaastiriin boba’aa manca’uu isaatti aansuun hojii gadhiisuu isaa ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun naannichatti rakkoolee jiran illee utuu jiraatanii, geejjibni boba’aa milkaa’aa akka ta’e agarsiisa.

title: India's security restrictions after Pahalgam attack throttle tourism income for Kashmiris
english: Following a deadly attack on tourists in Pahalgam in April 2025, Indian authorities imposed strict security measures that have devastated the local tourism industry. Residents of areas like Naranag, who rely heavily on trekking and hospitality services for their income, are facing severe financial losses due to these ongoing restrictions. This decline has significantly impacted the regional economy, affecting hundreds of thousands of people whose livelihoods depend on the sector.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በኤፕሪል 2025 በፓሃልጋም በተፈጸመው የቱሪስቶች ጥቃት ምክንያት የሕንድ ባለሥልጣናት የጣሉት ጥብቅ የጸጥታ እርምጃ በአካባቢው የቱሪዝም ዘርፍ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። በናራናግ እና በአካባቢው የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ገቢያቸውን በቱሪዝም እና በተራራ መውጣት አገልግሎት ላይ የሚመሠረቱ በመሆናቸው፣ በእነዚህ ገደቦች ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። ይህ የቱሪዝም ዘርፍ መቀዛቀዝ ከዘርፉ ጋር በተያያዘ ሥራ ላይ ለተሰማሩ በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ኑሮ አደጋ ላይ ጥሏል።
oromo: Mudii gaafa Ebla 2025 Pahalgam keessatti turistonni irratti raawwatamee ture hordofee, mootummaan Hindii tarkaanfii nageenyaa cimaa waan fudhateef, dameen turizimii naannichaa miidhamuu danda'eera. Namoonni naannoo Naranag jiraatan kanneen galii isaanii turizimii fi qajeelfamtoota gaara yaabuu (trekking) irratti hundaa'an, dhiibbaa kana hordofee kasaaraa dinagdee guddaa keessa galaniiru. Hir'inni turizimii kun namoota dhibba kumaatamaan lakka'aman kanneen jireenyi isaanii damee kana irratti xiyyeeffate miidhaarra buuseera.

title: Israeli settlers beat AFP photographer covering West Bank
english: A veteran AFP photographer, Jaafar Ashtiyeh, was hospitalized after being beaten by armed Israeli settlers while covering violence against olive farmers in the West Bank. During the incident, the attackers used rifle butts to strike the journalist as he attempted to reach his clearly marked press vehicle. Additionally, a Palestinian man was shot in the foot during the same confrontation, which involved gunfire from the settlers.
amharic: የኤኤፍፒ ፎቶግራፍ አንሺ የሆኑት ጃፋር አሽቲየህ በዌስት ባንክ በወይራ አርሶ አደሮች ላይ የሚፈጸመውን ጥቃት በመዘገብ ላይ እያሉ የታጠቁ እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎች በደረሱባቸው ድብደባ ሆስፒታል ገብተዋል። ጋዜጠኛው በጋዜጠኝነት ምልክት በተለየ መኪና ውስጥ ለመግባት ሲሞክሩ ጥቃት አድራሾቹ በጠመንጃ መደገፊያ ደብድበዋቸዋል። በተመሳሳይ ግጭት አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ በጠመንጃ ተመትቶ በእግሩ ላይ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል።
oromo: Suura-kaasuun dhaabbata oduu AFP Jaafar Ashtiyeh, naannoo Weest Baankitti qonnaan bultoota ejersaa irratti miidhaa raawwatamaa jiru gabaasaa osoo jiranii garee hidhateen reebamuun isaa ibsameera. Gaazexeessichi konkolaataa mallattoo miidiyaa qabu keessa galuuf osoo yaaluu, namoota hidhataniin qawwee isaaniitiin reebamee miidhaan irra ga'ee hospitaala ciiseera. Walitti bu'iinsa kana keessatti namni lammii Filisxeemii tokko immoo rasaasaan miilla isaa irratti madaa'eera.

title: German spy chief arrested for treason
english: August Hanning, the former director of Germany's foreign intelligence agency, has been arrested on serious charges of treason and espionage. Authorities allege he obtained classified government information through an accomplice to boost his private consulting business. Additionally, Hanning is embroiled in a separate criminal investigation involving an alleged plot to kidnap children during a high-profile custody dispute.
amharic: የጀርመን የውጭ መረጃ አገልግሎት የቀድሞ ኃላፊ የነበሩት ኦገስት ሃኒንግ በአገር ክህደት እና በሰላይነት ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው ታስረዋል። ባለስልጣኑ በመንግስት የተከለከሉ ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎችን ከአንድ ተባባሪ በመቀበል ለግል የንግድ ስራቸው እንደተጠቀሙበት ተገልጿል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም ሃኒንግ በህጻናት አፈና ሙከራ እና ከአንድ ከፍተኛ የፍርድ ቤት የልጆች አሳዳጊነት ክርክር ጋር በተያያዘ በወንጀል ምርመራ ውስጥ ተጠምደዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan duraanii tajaajila oduu qorannoo alaa Jarmanii, August Hanning, yakka gantuu fi basaasummaan himatamee qabameera. Namichi kun odeeffannoo dhokataa mootummaa gargaartuu isaa tokkoon argachaa ture hojii isaatiif fayyadamuun himatameera. Kana malees, Hanning dhimma ijoollee mana murtii keessatti falmii guddaa kaase wajjin walqabatee, yakka ijoollee butuuf yaaluu keessatti hirmaachuu isaatiin qorannoon irratti gaggeeffamaa jira.

title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
english: German authorities have arrested former intelligence chief August Hanning and a former colleague named Manfred D on charges of treason and espionage. Prosecutors allege that Manfred D leaked roughly 2,000 classified documents to Hanning, who then sold or shared this sensitive information with foreign intelligence agencies. Both men are currently in custody and facing serious legal proceedings regarding these security breaches.
amharic: የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት የቀድሞ የሀገሪቱን የደህንነት መሥሪያ ቤት ኃላፊ ኦገስት ሀኒንግን እና የቀድሞ ባልደረባቸውን ማንፍሬድ ዲ በሀገር ክህደት እና በሰላዮች ድርጊት ተጠርጥረው በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። አቃቤ ህግ እንደገለጸው ማንፍሬድ ዲ ወደ 2,000 የሚጠጉ ሚስጥራዊ ሰነዶችን ለሀኒንግ በማቀበል ሀኒንግ ደግሞ እነዚህን መረጃዎች ለውጭ ሀገር የስለላ ድርጅቶች እንዲሸጡ ወይም እንዲያጋሩ አድርገዋል። ሁለቱም ግለሰቦች አሁን በእስር ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን በፈጸሙት የደህንነት ጥሰት ምክንያት በህግ ፊት እየቀረቡ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Jarman hoggansa tika biyyattii duraanii August Hanning fi hojjetaa duraanii Manfred D jedhaman, yakka nageenya biyyaa dabarsuu fi basaasummaan himattee qabde. Abbaan alangaa akka ibsetti, Manfred D galmee iccitii qaban 2,000 ta'an gara Hanningitti erguudhaan, isaanis odeeffannoo kana dhaabbata basaasaa biyya alaa tokkoof gurguruu ykn qooduu isaa himateera. Namoonni lameen kun amma hidhaa keessa jiran yoo ta'u, dhimmi isaanii seeratti dhiyaachaa jira.

title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
english: Donald Trump faces intense criticism from California leaders after suggesting at a rally that Iran should be allowed to target Los Angeles and San Diego. The former president claimed these hypothetical attacks were a consequence of the tensions he navigated to keep the nation secure. In response, the White House defended his remarks, arguing that he was highlighting the dangers of a nuclear-armed Iran and insisting his policies have successfully neutralized those threats.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ላይ ኢራን የሎስ አንጀለስ እና ሳንዲያጎ ከተሞችን ማጥቃት ትችላለች በሚል የተናገሩት ንግግር በካሊፎርኒያ መሪዎች ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ይህንን የተናገሩት ሀገሪቱን ከአደጋ ለመጠበቅ ሲባል የወሰዱት እርምጃ አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ለማሳየት እንደሆነ ተከራክረዋል። የኋይት ሀውስ አስተዳደር ትራምፕ የኢራንን የኒውክሌር አቅም በመግታት ሀገሪቱን ደህንነቷ የተጠበቀ እንዲሆን ማድረጋቸውን በመግለጽ የትራምፕን ንግግር ተከላክሏል።
oromo: Donald Trump yaada walga'ii filannoo irratti 'Iraan magaalaawwan Los Angeles fi San Diego miidhuu dandeessi' jechuun dubbatan irratti hoggantoonni Kaalifoorniyaa mormii guddaa kaasaniiru. Preezidaantichi duraanii yaada kana kan dubbatan, biyyattii balaa irraa oolchuuf tarkaanfii fudhataniin walqabatee guddina nageenyaa ibsuuf akka ta'e ibsameera. Gama biraatiin, Mana Maree Adii (White House) yaada kana kan deeggaran yoo ta'u, tattaaffii inni Iraan irratti taasise biyyattii balaa niukleerii irraa bilisa baaseera jedhaniiru.

title: Lawyer for one of Cornell 7 calls for special prosecutor to be removed over previous comments
english: A defense lawyer for one of the seven men accused of a gang rape at Cornell University has requested that New York Attorney General Letitia James step down as special prosecutor. The lawyer argues that James’s public social media statements supporting the victim demonstrate a bias that compromises her impartiality. Meanwhile, the university is facing mounting pressure as faculty members prepare to hold a no-confidence vote regarding the administration’s handling of the incident.

title: More than 130,000 displaced inside Yemen amid renewed fighting: UNHCR

Maatiin isaa fi mootummaan Sri Lanka amma ariitiidhaan dhiifama akka godhamuuf carraaqa jiranis, ji'a Fulbaanaa booda ilmi isaanii bakka jiru akka hin beekne ibsaniiru.

title: Yemeni military says it has 'secured' Red Sea waterway
english: Pro-government forces in Yemen, supported by Saudi air power, have launched a significant military campaign to reclaim coastal areas from Houthi rebels. While the military claims to have secured the vital Bab al-Mandab Strait and parts of Mokha, reports regarding the extent of their control remain contradictory. Meanwhile, the conflict has intensified, with the Houthis retaliating through attacks on Saudi targets and international leaders expressing deep concern over the escalating violence.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ የአየር ድጋፍ የሚታገዙት የየመን የመንግስት ደጋፊ ኃይሎች ከሁቲ አማፂያን የባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢዎችን ለመውሰድ ትልቅ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ጀምረዋል። ጦር ኃይሉ ወሳኙን የባብ አል-ማንዳብ የባህር መተላለፊያ እና የሞካ ከተማን መቆጣጠሩን ቢገልጽም፣ በሌሎች ምንጮች ግን ሙሉ ቁጥጥር አለመደረጉ እየተነገረ ነው። በሌላ በኩል ሁቲዎች በሳውዲ ኢላማዎች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር አጸፋ እየመለሱ ሲሆን፣ ዓለም አቀፍ መሪዎችም ግጭቱ እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ከፍተኛ ስጋት አድሮባቸዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yemen kan deeggarsa qilleensaa Saudii Arabiyaa argatan, naannolee qarqara galaanaa finxaaleyyii Huutii irraa deebisanii to'achuuf duula waraanaa bal'aa jalqabaniiru. Humnoonni waraanaa kun daandii galaanaa ba'ii fi seensaa Bab al-Mandabii fi kutaa magaalaa Mokhaa to'achuu isaanii kan ibsan ta'us, gabaasotni garuu to'annoon sun guutuu ta'uu isaa irratti shakkii qabu. Gama biraatiin, gareen Huutii weerara Saudii irratti deebii kan kennan ta'uun, hogganootni biyyoolessaa immoo waraanni kun daran hammaachaa waan jiruuf yaaddoo guddaa qabaachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Kenya confirms its first Ebola death as outbreak spreads
english: Kenya has reported its first Ebola-related death involving a citizen who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The individual sought medical treatment in Nairobi after arriving by plane, where testing later confirmed they were infected with the Bundibugyo virus. This incident occurs amidst a severe and ongoing Ebola outbreak in the neighboring DRC that has caused thousands of fatalities.
amharic: ኬንያ ከኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተመለሰ ዜጋ በኢቦላ በሽታ መሞቱን አረጋግጣለች። ግለሰቡ ናይሮቢ ከደረሰ በኋላ በሆስፒታል ህክምና ሲደረግለት የቆየ ቢሆንም፣ በተደረገለት ምርመራ የቡንዲቡግዮ የኢቦላ ቫይረስ እንደተገኘበት ተረጋግጧል። ይህ ክስተት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተስፋፋ ባለው እና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ አካል ነው።
oromo: Keeniyaan lammii biyyattii kan biyya Koongoo irraa deebi'e tokko dhukkuba Iboolaatiin du'uu isaa mirkaneessiteetti. Namichi kun Naayiroobii erga galee booda hospitaala keessatti yaalamaa kan ture yoo ta'u, qorannoon inni godhameef vaayirasii Iboolaa 'Bundibugyo' irratti argameera. Gootummaan kun kan mudate yeroo dhibeen Iboolaa biyya Koongoo keessatti babal'atee namoota kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman galaafachaa jirutti.

title: Nigeria mourns 32 killed as military plane crashes into swamp
english: President Bola Tinubu has announced three days of national mourning following a tragic military plane crash in Ondo State that claimed the lives of all 32 people on board. The aircraft was traveling from Benin City to Lagos when it went down in a swampy area near a naval base. The government has ordered flags to be flown at half-mast and launched a comprehensive investigation to determine why the accident occurred.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ቦላ ቲኑቡ በኦንዶ ግዛት በተከሰተው የወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን አደጋ የ32 ሰዎች ሕይወት ማለፉን ተከትሎ የሦስት ቀናት የሐዘን ቀንን አውጀዋል። አውሮፕላኑ ከቤኒን ሲቲ ወደ ላጎስ በመጓዝ ላይ እያለ ከባህር ኃይል ጣቢያ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ረግረጋማ ቦታ ላይ ተከስክሷል። መንግስት ብሔራዊ ባንዲራዎች በግማሽ ዝቅ ብለው እንዲውለበለቡ ያዘዘ ሲሆን፣ የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማጣራትም ምርመራ ተጀምሯል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Bola Tiinuubuu balaa xiyyaara waraanaa naannoo Ondoo keessatti mudateen lubbuun namoota 32 darbuun walqabatee guyyoota sadiif gadda biyyaalessaa labsaniiru. Xiyyaarichi magaalaa Biniin irraa gara Laagoos imalaa osoo jiruu naannoo buufata humna galaanaatti lafa dhoqqeessaatti kufuu isaa ibsameera. Mootummaan alaangaan biyyaalessaa akka gadi qabamu ajajee, sababa balaa kanaa qorachuufis qorannoo bal’aa jalqabeera.

title: Sahibzada Farhan named Pakistan’s T20 captain as Naseem Shah returns
english: Sahibzada Farhan has been appointed as Pakistan’s new T20 cricket captain, replacing Salman Ali Agha ahead of the upcoming home series against Sri Lanka. The squad sees the return of fast bowler Naseem Shah and batter Hasan Nawaz, while rising talent Razaullah has been included for his first white-ball appearance. Additionally, former Australian player Shaun Tait has taken over as the team's new bowling coach.
amharic: ሳሂብዛዳ ፋርሃን በቅርቡ በሚካሄደው ከስሪላንካ ጋር በሚደረገው የቲ-20 ውድድር የፓኪስታን ብሄራዊ ቡድን አዲስ አሰልጣኝ በመሆን ሰልማን አሊ አጋን ተክተዋል። ቡድኑ የፈጣን አሳላፊውን ናሲም ሻህን እና ባተር ሀሰን ናዋዝን ወደ ስብስቡ የመለሰ ሲሆን፣ በሙከራ ግጥሚያዎች ጥሩ አቋም ያሳየው ረዛኡላህም ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በነጭ ኳስ ውድድር ተካቷል። በተጨማሪም የቀድሞው አውስትራሊያዊ ተጫዋች ሻውን ታይት የቡድኑ አዲሱ የቦውሊንግ አሰልጣኝ ሆነው ተሹመዋል።
oromo: Sahibzada Farhan gaggeessaa garee kirikeetii T20 kan Paakistaan ta'ee muudamee jira, inniis Salman Ali Agha bakka bu'ee waldaa Sri Lanka wajjin taphatamuuf qophaa'aa jira. Gareen kun ariifachiisaa kubbaa Naseem Shah fi taphataa Hasan Nawaz deebisee kan of keessatti hammatu yoo ta'u, taphataa haaraa Razaullah jedhamus carraa argatee jira. Kana malees, taphataa Awustiraaliyaa duraanii Shaun Tait leenjisaa kubbaa darbuu (bowling coach) ta'ee hojiitti seenee jira.

title: Yemen war: What’s the latest on the battlefield?
english: Yemen's government forces, supported by a Saudi-led coalition, have launched a new operation to reclaim territory from Houthi rebels along the western coast. This offensive follows recent Houthi gains near the strategic Bab el-Mandeb Strait and aims to recapture major areas, including the capital city of Sanaa. While government officials report significant territorial victories near Taiz and Mocha, the Houthi group disputes these claims and has retaliated by targeting sites within Saudi Arabia.
amharic: በሳዑዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት የሚደግፈው የየመን መንግስት በምዕራብ የባህር ጠረፍ በሁቲ አማፂያን የተያዙ ቦታዎችን መልሶ ለመቆጣጠር አዲስ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ጀምሯል። ይህ ጥረት የሁቲ ቡድን በቅርቡ በባብ ኤል-ማንዴብ የባህር መተላለፊያ አካባቢ ካስመዘገበው ድል በኋላ የመንግስት ሃይሎችን አቋም ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። የመንግስት ወታደሮች በታይዝ እና ሞቻ አካባቢ ድል መቀዳጀታቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ የሁቲ ቡድን ግን ዘገባዎቹን አስተባብሎ በሳዑዲ አረቢያ ላይ የጠላትነት እርምጃዎችን መውሰዱን ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yaman kan deggarsa koalishinii Saudii argatu, bakkeewwan gama dhihaa irraa loltoota Huutii harkaa baasuuf duula haarawaa eegaleera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufu, gareen Huutii dhiheenya kana daandii galaana Bab el-Mandeb irratti injifannoo argachuu isaa hordofee dha. Loltoonni mootummaa naannawa Taayiz fi Mocha keessatti injifannoo argachuu isaanii yoo ibsan, gareen Huutii garuu gabaasa kana haaluun, biyya Saudi Arabia keessatti bakkeewwan addaddaatti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: Harmanpreet Kaur steps down as captain of India’s women’s cricket team
english: Harmanpreet Kaur has officially resigned from her role as captain of the Indian women’s cricket team across all formats. Over her long tenure, she achieved significant milestones, including leading the team to their first-ever ICC Women’s World Cup victory in 2025. She holds the record for captaining the most T20I matches in international cricket history. Her deputy, Smriti Mandhana, is currently the top candidate to succeed her as the team leader.
amharic: የህንድ የሴቶች ክሪኬት ቡድን ካፒቴን የነበረችው ሃርማንፕሪት ካውር ከሁሉም የጨዋታ ዘርፎች በካፒቴንነት ስልጣን መልቀቋን አስታውቃለች። በቆይታዋ ቡድኑን በ2025 የመጀመሪያውን የዓለም ዋንጫ ድል እንዲቀዳጅ በመምራት ታላቅ ስኬት አስመዝግባለች። እሷም በዓለም አቀፍ የክሪኬት ታሪክ ብዙ የቲ-20 ጨዋታዎችን በመምራት ክብረ ወሰን የያዘች ስፖርተኛ ነች። ተተኪዋ ትሆናለች ተብሎ የሚጠበቀው ምክትሏ ስምሪቲ ማንዳና ናት።
oromo: Hoggantuun garee cricket dubartoota Hindii kan turte Harmanpreet Kaur, sadarkaa hunda irraas hogganummaa ishee gadhiisuu ishee beeksisteetti. Yeroo dheeraa tureen, gareen ishee bara 2025 yeroo jalqabaaf wancaa addunyaa akka mo'atu gochuun injifannoo guddaa galmeessiteetti. Isheenis seenaa cricket idil-addunyaa keessatti taphoota T20I hedduu hogganuun rekordii qabdi. Iddoo isheettis gargaartuun ishee Smriti Mandhana hoggantuu haaraa ta'uun ishee ni eegama.

title: Are pets replacing human babies?
english: Many individuals are increasingly choosing to raise pets rather than start families, which has led to a significant expansion in the pet care market. This shift reflects broader societal changes that are causing a decline in global birth rates. Experts are currently investigating the complex personal and economic reasons behind this growing trend among younger generations.
amharic: ብዙ ሰዎች ልጆችን ከመውለድ ይልቅ የቤት እንስሳትን ለማሳደግ እየመረጡ መምጣታቸው ለቤት እንስሳት እንክብካቤ ኢንዱስትሪ ትልቅ እድገት ፈጥሯል። ይህ ለውጥ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የወሊድ መጠን እንዲቀንስ ካደረጉት ማህበራዊ ለውጦች አንዱ ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል። ባለሙያዎች በወጣቶች ዘንድ እየታየ ያለው ይህ ዝንባሌ ከምን የመነጨ እንደሆነ እና ከኋላው ያሉትን የኢኮኖሚ እና የማህበራዊ ምክንያቶች እየመረመሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namoonni hedduun ijoollee godhachuu mannaa beeyiladoota manaa kunuunfachuu filachaa jiru, kunis daldala kunuunsa beeyiladootaa guddisteera. Jijjiiramni kun hawaasni waliigalaan ijoollee godhachuu akka hir'ise agarsiisa. Ogeeyyiin sababoota dinagdee fi hawaasummaa guddachaa jiru kana irratti qorannoo godhaa jiru.

title: Trump approves firing squad execution for Fort Hood attacker Nidal Hasan
english: President Donald Trump has authorized the execution of Nidal Hasan, a former army psychiatrist who murdered 13 people at Fort Hood in 2009. The execution will be carried out by a firing squad, marking the first time a U.S. soldier will face the death penalty by the military in over six decades. This rare military order follows a recommendation by the Defense Secretary and signifies a major shift in how capital punishment is applied within the armed forces.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እ.ኤ.አ በ2009 በፎርት ሁድ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ 13 ሰዎችን የገደለውን የቀድሞ የጦር ሰራዊት የሥነ-አእምሮ ሐኪም ኒዳል ሀሰንን በጥይት ተኩስ እንዲገደል ፈቅደዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከ60 ዓመታት በላይ በዘለለ ጊዜ ውስጥ በወታደራዊ ፍርድ ቤት የሞት ቅጣት የተፈረደበት የመጀመሪያው የአሜሪካ ወታደር ያደርገዋል። የዚህ ብርቅዬ ውሳኔ ትግበራ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ ምክር የታከለበት ሲሆን፣ ቅጣቱ የሚፈጸምበትን ጊዜ እና ቦታ የሰራዊቱ ኃላፊዎች ይወስናሉ።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Donald Traamp nama bara 2009 buufata waraanaa Foort Huud keessatti namoota 13 ajjeese, kan duraan ogeessa sammuu waraanaa ture Nidaal Hasaan irratti adabbii du'aa rasaasaan akka raawwatamu ajajaniiru. Murtuun kun waggaa 60 oliif waraana Ameerikaa keessatti kan hin mul'anne yoo ta'u, Hasaan waraana Ameerikaa keessatti adabbiin du'aa irratti murtaa'ee raawwatamuuf kan jalqabaa ta'a. Murtuun kun gorsa Ministira Ittisaatiin kan mirkanaa'e yoo ta'u, yeroofi bakki adabbiin kun itti raawwatamu ammoo hoggansa waraanaatiin kan murtaa'u ta'a.

title: Trump says taxpayers will no longer fund TV ads that praise him
english: President Donald Trump has announced that he will stop using public funds for television advertisements that highlight his accomplishments. This decision follows significant backlash from ethics experts and lawmakers who argued that the government-funded commercials were essentially political campaign material. Going forward, these advertisements will be financed exclusively by his own personal funds or his political action committee.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እሳቸውን የሚያሞካሹ የቴሌቪዥን ማስታወቂያዎችን ለመስራት የመንግስት በጀት መጠቀም እንደሚያቆሙ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው፣ በማስታወቂያዎቹ ላይ የመንግስት ገንዘብ መባከኑን በመቃወም በስነ-ምግባር ባለሙያዎችና በፖለቲከኞች ለቀረበው ከፍተኛ ትችት ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው። ከዚህ በኋላ እነዚህ ማስታወቂያዎች የሚሸፈኑት በግል ሀብታቸው ወይም በፖለቲካ ድርጅታቸው ድጋፍ ብቻ ይሆናል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp, ofii isaanii galateeffatu ykn haala gaariin ibsu kan jedhaman beeksisaa TV irratti baasuuf baajata mootummaa fayyadamuu akka dhaaban ibsaniiru. Murtuun kun kan dhufe, beeksisoonni kun qabeenya mootummaatiin bahuun isaanii dogoggora akka ta'e ogeeyyota naamusaafi paartilee siyaasaa irraa balaaleffannaan cimaan erga isaan mudatee booda. Kana booda beeksisoonni kunneen maallaqa ofii isaaniitiin ykn dhaabbata siyaasaa isaaniitiin qofa kan raawwataman ta'a.

title: Turkiye, Pakistan to deploy forces to Saudi as Yemen fighting grows
english: Turkiye and Pakistan have reached an agreement to send rapid response military units to Saudi Arabia. This decision follows emergency discussions held in Riyadh amid an intensifying conflict in Yemen. The move comes as Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces initiate a counter-offensive to reclaim territory from Houthi rebels.

oromo: Turkiif Paakistaan waraana hatattamaan bobba'u danda'u gara Saudii Arabiyaatti erguuf waliigalteerra ga'aniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, waraanni mootummaa Yaman kanneen Saudii Arabiyaan deggeraman, lafa Hutiin qabatanii turan deebisanii to'achuuf duula eegaluun isaanitiin walqabatee dha.

title: Former ‘American Idol’ singer Caleb Flynn gets life for wife’s murder
english: Caleb Flynn, who previously appeared as a contestant on American Idol, has been sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole. He was found guilty of killing his wife and subsequently trying to hide evidence of the murder. The court's ruling ensures he will spend the rest of his life behind bars for his actions.
amharic: ቀድሞ የአሜሪካን አይዶል ተወዳዳሪ የነበረው ካሌብ ፍሊን፣ ሚስቱን በመግደልና ወንጀሉን ለመደበቅ በመሞከሩ የእድሜ ልክ እስራት ተፈረደበት። ፍርድ ቤቱ ያለ ይቅርታ ዕድሜ ልክ እስራት በመወሰኑ፣ ተከሳሹ የቀረውን ህይወቱን በሙሉ እስር ቤት ያሳልፋል።

title: Syrian Airlines unveils laser-sharp look for the future
english: Syrian Airlines has introduced a refreshed brand identity during a recent event at Damascus Airport. The updates include a new visual style, improvements to payment systems, and a digital booking experience. Additionally, the airline is set to release a dedicated mobile application for customers this November.
amharic: የሶሪያ አየር መንገድ በደማስቆ አየር ማረፊያ በተካሄደ ስነ-ስርዓት አዲስ የድርጅት ገጽታን አስተዋውቋል። ለውጦቹ አዲስ የካምፓኒ ዲዛይንን፣ የተሻሻሉ የክፍያ አማራጮችን እና ዘመናዊ የቦታ ማስያዣ ስርዓቶችን ያካትታሉ። እንዲሁም አየር መንገዱ በሚቀጥለው ህዳር ወር ለደንበኞቹ የሚሆን አዲስ የሞባይል አፕሊኬሽን ይፋ ያደርጋል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri Suuriyaa (Syrian Airlines) buufata xiyyaaraa Damaasqootti sirna geggeeffameen mallattoo fi bifa haaraa ofii isaa ifa godheera. Fooyya'iinsi kun bocca bifa haaraa, sirna kaffaltii fooyya'e fi haala salphaa ta'een bakka qabachuu kan of keessatti qabatuudha. Kana malees, qondaaltoonni xiyyaaraa ji'a Sadaasaa dhufu keessa appilikeeshinii moobayilaa haaraa hojiitti akka galchan beekameera.

title: Moroccan journalists recount years of surveillance amid new Amnesty claim
english: A recent Amnesty International report alleges that the Moroccan government has been using sophisticated Pegasus spyware to monitor and silence local journalists, activists, and critics. The investigation, supported by testimony from a whistleblower, details the experiences of several individuals, including journalist Omar Radi, who describe constant digital and physical tracking. While Moroccan authorities deny these claims, the report highlights serious concerns regarding the suppression of human rights and the lack of judicial fairness for those targeted.
amharic: የአምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል አዲስ ሪፖርት የሞሮኮ መንግስት ጋዜጠኞችን፣ አክቲቪስቶችን እና ተቺዎችን ለመቆጣጠር እና ዝም ለማሰኘት የፔጋሰስ የስለላ ሶፍትዌርን እንደሚጠቀም ይከሳል። ከውስጥ አዋቂ ግለሰብ በተገኘ መረጃ የተደገፈው ይህ ጥናት ጋዜጠኛ ኦማር ራዲን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ግለሰቦች ላይ የሚደረግ የዲጂታል እና የአካል ክትትልን በዝርዝር ያሳያል። የሞሮኮ ባለስልጣናት ክሱን አስተባብለዋል፤ ሆኖም ሪፖርቱ በሰብአዊ መብቶች መገደብ እና በፍትህ ስርዓቱ አድልዎ ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraa 'Amnesty International' akka ibsutti, mootummaan Marookoo gabaastota, sochii mirga namoomaa gaggeessitootaa fi warra isaan morman to’achuufi afaan qabachiisuufi mala hordoffii 'Pegasus' fayyadamaa jira. Qorannoon kun ragaa nama dhimma kana keessa tureerraa argameen kan deeggarame yoo ta'u, miidhaa gabaastuu Oomar Raadii dabalatee namoota hedduurratti raawwatamee fi hordoffii dijitaalaafi qaamaa irratti taasifamu ifa godha. Mootummaan Marookoo himata kana kan haalu yoo ta'u, gabaasichi mirgoota namoomaa sarbamuufi sirna haqaa keessatti dogoggora jiruuf yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
english: President Donald Trump confirmed that the United States relocated its bomber fleet from RAF Fairford in the UK due to specific security threats. While officials have not provided exact details, reports suggest the decision followed concerns about potential sabotage or targeted strikes near the airbase. The US military took these risks seriously and opted to move the aircraft to avoid leaving them vulnerable.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በዩኬ የሚገኘውን የቦምብ ጣይ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያዋን RAF Fairford የለቀቀችው በደህንነት ስጋቶች ምክንያት መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። ምንም እንኳን ስለ ስጋቱ ዝርዝር መረጃ ባይሰጥም፣ ውሳኔው የመሰረተ ልማት ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል እንደተወሰደ ይታመናል። የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አመራሮች እነዚህን ስጋቶች በጣም በቁም ነገር በመመልከት አውሮፕላኖቹን ወደ ደህና ቦታ ማዛወራቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaanald Traamp akka jedhanitti, biyyi isaanii xiyyaarota boombii fe'an buufata RAF Feerfoordi irraa kan kaaste soda nageenyaa mudatee tureefidha. title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election
english: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has called for an early election on November 29 following a major legislative setback regarding housing policy. His government is currently facing significant political pressure due to corruption scandals, investigations into his family, and a difficult migration crisis. By focusing his campaign on the housing crisis, Sánchez hopes to shift public attention away from these controversies and secure a stronger majority for his left-wing coalition.

title: ‘Smash the patriarchy’: Activists graffiti Cornell hall over gang rape case
english: Protesters at Cornell University vandalized an administrative building to demand justice following a 2024 gang rape case involving a campus fraternity. Activists are calling for systemic reforms, the end of Greek life, and stricter punishment for sexual assault, accusing the university of failing to protect survivors. While school officials have condemned the property damage, the ongoing legal battle continues to ignite national discussions about sexual violence on American college campuses.
amharic: የኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪዎች በ2024 በአንድ የተማሪዎች ማህበር ውስጥ ተፈጽሟል በተባለ አስገድዶ መድፈር ወንጀል ዙሪያ ፍትህን በመጠየቅ የአስተዳደር ህንፃ ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። አክቲቪስቶች ዩኒቨርሲቲው ለተጎጂዎች ጥበቃ አላደረገም በማለት የተማሪዎች ማህበራት እንዲታገዱ እና ለጾታዊ ጥቃት ፈጻሚዎች ጠንከር ያለ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ እየጠየቁ ነው። የዩኒቨርሲቲው አስተዳደር ንብረት ማውደም ተገቢ አይደለም ቢልም፣ ጉዳዩ በአሜሪካ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ውስጥ እየተከሰተ ስላለው የጾታዊ ጥቃት ችግር አገራዊ ውይይት ቀስቅሷል።
oromo: Barattoonni Yuunivarsitii Cornell, bara 2024 gareedhaan nama gudeeduun raawwatame jedhamee shakkamu irratti hiriira mormii guddaa dhageessisaniiru. Hiriirtonni kun yuunivarsitiin kun miidhamtootaaf ittisa gahaa hin taasisne jechuun, waldaaleen barattootaa (fraternities) akka cufamaniifi fudhattoonni yakka kanaa irratti tarkaanfiin cimaan akka fudhatamu gaafataniiru. Bulchiinsi yuunivarsitichaa miidhaa qabeenyaa irratti gahe balaaleffatus, dhimmi kun gudeeddii dhaabbilee barnoota ol-aanoo keessatti raawwatamu irratti falmii biyyoolessaa uumeera.

title: Super-subs help France demolish Belgium with late flurry
english: France secured a convincing 4-1 victory against Belgium in their Nations League match after trailing for much of the game. Substitutes Desire Doue, Rayan Cherki, and Michael Olise changed the momentum by scoring four goals in the final 15 minutes. This win keeps France at the top of their group, ahead of Italy and Belgium.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ በኔሽንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ቤልጂየምን 4 ለ 1 በሆነ ውጤት በማሸነፍ ወሳኝ ድል አስመዝግባለች። ጨዋታው በቤልጂየም መሪነት ቢቀጥልም፣ ተቀይረው የገቡት ተጫዋቾች ዴዚሬ ዱዌ፣ ረያን ሸርኪ እና ሚካኤል ኦሊሴ በመጨረሻዎቹ 15 ደቂቃዎች ውስጥ አራት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር የጨዋታውን ውጤት ቀይረውታል። በዚህ ውጤትም ፈረንሳይ ከጣሊያን እና ከቤልጂየም በመቅደም የምድቧን የደረጃ ሰንጠረዥ በበላይነት እየመራች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Faransaay tapha 'Nations League' irratti Beeljiyeemii wajjin taphatteen 4 fi 1 injifachuun galata guddaa galteetti. Beeljiyeem durfamtee kan turte yoo ta'u, taphattoonni bakka bu'anii galan kanneen akka Deziiree Duwee, Raayaan Sherkii fi Miikaa'eel Oliisee daqiiqaa 15n dhumaa keessatti goolii afran galchuun qabxii taphichaa jijjiiranii jiru. Injifannoo kanaanis Faransaay, Xaaliyaanii fi Beeljiyeemii dursuun sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti argamti.

title: Brazil’s presidential race head for a tough runoff
english: Brazil is preparing for a highly competitive presidential runoff election following a first round that showed significant strength for the right-wing movement. Despite being the incumbent, President Lula da Silva faces a challenging path to secure another term. The political landscape is further complicated by a high voter turnout issue, as over 29 million citizens chose not to participate in the initial vote.
amharic: ብራዚል ከምርጫው የመጀመሪያ ዙር በኋላ ከፍተኛ ፉክክር የሚታይበት የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ ሁለተኛ ዙር ለማድረግ እየተዘጋጀች ነው። የአሁኑ ፕሬዚዳንት ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ ስልጣን ለመያዝ ከባድ ፈተና ተጋርጦባቸዋል፤ ምክንያቱም የቀኝ ዘመም እንቅስቃሴዎች በፓርላማ ከፍተኛ ድጋፍ እያገኙ ነው። ከዚህም በላይ ከ29 ሚሊዮን በላይ መራጮች በምርጫው አለመሳተፋቸው የምርጫውን ሂደት ይበልጥ አወዛጋቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Brazil filannoo duraa booda dorgommiin cimaan akka itti fufuuf qophii gochaa jirti. Preezidaant Lula da Silvaa irra deebiin filatamachuuf qormaata cimaa keessa jiru, sababni isaas gareen mirgaa (right-wing) mana maree keessatti deggarsa guddaa argataa jira. Kana malees, namoonni miliyoona 29 ol ta'an sagalee kennuu dhiisuun isaanii haala filannichaa caalaatti ulfaataa taasiseera.

title: Houthis target Riyadh airpot, declare Saudi airspace open target except for holy sites
english: Houthi forces in Yemen have launched a drone strike against King Khaled International Airport in Riyadh, marking their second attack on the facility. The group warned that Saudi airspace is now considered an active combat zone, excluding only the holy sites of Makkah and Madinah. They claim the strike was a direct retaliation for recent Saudi military actions and have advised against using the country's flight paths.
amharic: በየመን የሚንቀሳቀሱት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ በሚገኘው የንጉሥ ካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ታጣቂዎቹ የሳውዲ የአየር ክልል ለጥቃታቸው ክፍት መሆኑን አስታውቀው፣ የመካ እና የመዲና ቅዱሳን ቦታዎች ብቻ ከዚህ ውጪ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በሳውዲ በኩል ለሚወሰዱ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ምላሽ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni Huthotaa kan Yaman, buufata xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa King Khaled kan magaalaa Riyaaditti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwateera. Gareen kun, qilleensii Saudii bakkeewwan qulqulluu Makkah fi Madiinaa ala haleellaa isaaniitiif banaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Haleellaan kun tarkaanfii waraana Saudi qaqqabsiisaa jirtuuf deebii ta'uu himuun, qilleensa biyyattii fayyadamuu akka dhaaban akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: CIA report warns of civil conflict and 'collapse' in Israel: Report
english: A recent internal CIA assessment warns that Israel is facing a high risk of civil war or societal collapse due to escalating internal tensions. The report highlights deep disagreements regarding military service exemptions for ultra-Orthodox citizens and concerns about post-war economic instability and settler violence. With a critical election approaching and political coalitions fracturing, experts suggest that the country’s stability is increasingly threatened from within.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የሲአይኤ ሪፖርት በእስራኤል ውስጥ እየጨመረ በመጣው የውስጥ ውጥረት ምክንያት የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ወይም የመንግስት መፍረስ አደጋ ሊከሰት እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቋል። ሪፖርቱ በተለይ በአልትራ-ኦርቶዶክስ ዜጎች ወታደራዊ አገልግሎት ነፃ መሆን ዙሪያ ያለውን ከፍተኛ አለመግባባት እና ከጦርነቱ በኋላ የተፈጠረውን የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እንደ ዋና የችግር ምንጭ ይጠቅሳል። መጪው ምርጫ የሀገሪቱን የፖለቲካ ጥምረት የበለጠ በማተራመስ የመንግስትን መረጋጋት አደጋ ላይ ሊጥለው እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Gabaasni dhiheenya CIA baase tokko, Israa'el keessatti walitti bu'iinsa uumamaa jiruun wal qabatee balaan waraana keessoo ykn kufaatii mootummaa mudachuu akka danda'u akeekkachiiseera. Gabaasichi, gaaffii tajaajila waraanaa namoota Ultra-Orthodox irratti uumamee fi rakkoo dinagdee waraana boodaa akka sababa guguddaatti eeru. Filannoon dhiyaachaa jiru kun michummaa siyaasaa biyyattii daran laaffisuun, tasgabbii biyyattii balaaf saaxiluu akka danda'u ogeeyyoonni ni dubbatu.

title: Houthis claim Mocha still under their control
english: A Houthi official named Fuad Sinan released a video from Mocha city to dispute reports that Saudi-backed forces had captured the area. He walked through the streets to demonstrate that his group remains in control of the city. This statement directly contradicts recent claims suggesting the city had fallen to opposing fighters.
amharic: የሁቲ የውጭ ጉዳይ ምክትል አስተዳዳሪ የሆኑት ፋድ ሲናን፣ በሳዑዲ የሚደገፉ ኃይሎች የሞካ ከተማን ተቆጣጠርን በሚል ያሰራጩትን መረጃ አስተባብለዋል። በከተማዋ ጎዳናዎች ላይ በመንቀሳቀስ መቅረጻቸው በተሰማው የቪዲዮ ማስረጃ፣ ከተማዋ አሁንም በቁጥጥራቸው ስር መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የከተማዋን መያዝ በተመለከተ የተነገሩትን ዘገባዎች ውድቅ የሚያደርግ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Houthi, Fuad Sinan jedhaman, oduu humnoonni Sa'udii deeggaraman magaalaa Mocha qabataniiru jedhamu soba jechuun haalaniiru. Innis qabxii kana mirkaneessuuf, magaalaa Mocha keessa deemee suuraa fi sagalee isaa gadhiiseera. Taateen kun oduun magaalaan sun qabamte jedhame dhugaa akka hin taane ibsa.

title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan activate Mecca Pact amid war with Houthis
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have activated the Mecca Pact, a mutual defense alliance that involves the rapid deployment of foreign troops to the kingdom. This decision follows an emergency meeting in Riyadh aimed at condemning security threats against Saudi Arabia amid a new military offensive against Houthi forces. While the immediate tactical impact of this deployment remains uncertain, the move serves as a significant show of international support for the Saudi-led campaign.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን ‘የመካ ስምምነት’ የተሰኘውን የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተግባራዊ ማድረጋቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ስምምነት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎችን ለመከላከል በሚደረገው ጥረት የጋራ ወታደራዊ ድጋፍን እና የሰራዊት ስምሪትን ያካትታል። እርምጃው በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል ያለመ ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የደህንነት ትብብር የሚያጠናክር ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkii fi Paakistaan waligaltee ittisa biyyaalessaa 'Mecca Pact' jedhamu hojiirra oolchuuf murteessaniiru. Murteen kun humnoota Huutii cabsuuf jecha, waraana biyyoota lamaanii gara Saudii Arabiyaatti erguu kan dabalatuudha. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyoota sadan kana gidduutti walitti dhufeenya nageenyaa kan cimsu yoo ta'u, Saudii Arabiyaa irratti weerara geggeeffamu ittisuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Trump says Saudi, Yemeni attacks against Houthis will work out 'very well'
english: President Donald Trump expressed confidence regarding the ongoing military campaign led by Saudi Arabia and its allies against Houthi forces. When asked about the offensive, he suggested that the situation would result in a successful outcome. He remains optimistic that these coordinated attacks will prove effective in the region.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና አጋሮቿ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ እየወሰዱ ባለው ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ላይ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል። ስለ ጥቃቱ የተጠየቁት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ ጉዳዩ በጥሩ ሁኔታ እንደሚጠናቀቅ ተስፋቸውን ገልጸዋል። እነዚህ የተቀናጁ ጥቃቶች በክልሉ አወንታዊ ውጤት እንደሚያመጡም ያላቸውን አመለካከት አሳይተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp, sa'udii arabiyaa fi gargaartonni ishee loltoota Huutii irratti duula waraanaa gaggeessaa jiraniif amanannaa qaban ibsaniiru. Duula kana ilaalchisee gaaffii gaafatamaniin, haalli kun karaa gaariin akka xumuramuu danda'u dubbataniiru. Tarkaanfiiwwan waloon fudhatamaa jiran kun naannichatti bu'aa gaarii akka fidan abdii qaban ibsaniiru.

title: No10 insists UK military base RAF Fairford is safe after US withdraws bombers
english: The British government has stated that RAF Fairford remains secure following the US military's decision to relocate its bombers back to America. While reports suggest the withdrawal was a response to security threats and a recent police investigation into suspicious activity near the base, US officials describe the move as a routine operational change. UK authorities maintain full confidence in the safety measures protecting the site despite the ongoing counter-terrorism inquiries.

title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests
english: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has announced a snap general election for November 29 following parliamentary defeats regarding his proposed housing reforms. The decision follows widespread public protests sparked by rising rental costs and the eviction of elderly citizens. Sánchez hopes this early vote will help him secure a stronger parliamentary majority to effectively address the nation's housing crisis and other ongoing political challenges.

english: A 15-year-old student suffered a severe hand injury during violent clashes between protesters and police outside a high school in Lens, France. title: Nobel Prize awarded for revealing inner workings of the brain
english: Three scientists, Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel, have been awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for pioneering optogenetics. This revolutionary technique uses light to control brain cells, allowing researchers to map neural circuits and better understand complex behaviors, feelings, and memories. By turning specific neurons on or off, this discovery is advancing medical treatments, including efforts to restore vision in the visually impaired.

english: A Nigerian military aircraft carrying 32 people crashed in Ondo state while flying from Benin to Lagos. Aviation authorities have located the wreckage near a naval base and have initiated search-and-rescue efforts. While the status of those on board remains uncertain, officials are working to assess the situation and provide necessary assistance.

title: Yemeni gov’t forces aim for Sanaa, but Houthi defeat will be a challenge
english: Yemeni government forces, supported by Saudi Arabia, have launched a significant military campaign to reclaim territories held by the Houthis, including the capital city of Sanaa. The military recently made progress near the Bab al-Mandeb strait and recaptured areas like Mocha, but experts warn that internal divisions and outdated equipment make a total victory difficult. While both sides are escalating the conflict, analysts suggest that a negotiated settlement remains more likely than a decisive military defeat for either party.

title: Latest US military strike on alleged drug boat kills four in Caribbean
english: The US military recently conducted a strike on a boat in the Caribbean suspected of drug trafficking, resulting in the deaths of four people. This operation is part of the ongoing 'Operation Southern Spear,' which has caused at least 235 deaths across 70 strikes since last year. While the US claims these actions are necessary to combat cartels, international experts have raised serious concerns that these strikes violate international law.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር ተጠርጣሪ ጀልባ ላይ በካሪቢያን ባህር ባደረሰው ጥቃት አራት ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ካለፈው ዓመት ጀምሮ ሲካሄድ በቆየው 'ኦፕሬሽን ደቡባዊ ጦር' ዘመቻ አካል ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን ባደረገው 70 ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ 235 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። አሜሪካ ጥቃቱ አደንዛዥ ዕፅን ለመቆጣጠር አስፈላጊ ነው ብትልም፣ ዓለም አቀፍ ባለሙያዎች ግን ድርጊቱ ዓለም አቀፍ ሕግን የሚጥስ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa markabii qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu (drug) geejsa jedhamee shakkame tokko irratti Caribeanitti erga fudhataniin lubbuun namoota afurii darbeera. Hojii waraanaa 'Operation Southern Spear' jedhamu kanaan, waggaa darbee kaasee guutuu naannichatti duula 70 gaggeeffameen namoonni 235 ol ta'an ajjeefamaniiru. Ameerikaan tarkaanfichi garee yakkaatiin falmuuf barbaachisaa dha yoo jetteyyuu, ogeeyyiin idil-addunyaa garuu gochi kun seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsu ta'uu fi miidhaa guddaa geessisuu akka danda'u ibsaniiru.

title: Muferihat Takes Upper House Helm
english: Muferihat Kamil has been appointed as the new Speaker of the House of Federation for a five-year term, following a transition within the Prosperity Party government. She replaces Agegnehu Teshager, while Desta Ledamo has been named the new Deputy Speaker. Muferihat brings extensive leadership experience, having previously served as a minister and as the first female Speaker of the House of Peoples' Representatives.
amharic: ሙፈሪያት ካሚል ለሚቀጥሉት አምስት ዓመታት የፌዴሬሽን ምክር ቤት አፈ-ጉባኤ ሆነው ተመርጠዋል። ከዚህ ቀደም የነበሩትን አፈ-ጉባኤ አገኘሁ ተሻገርን በመተካት ወደ ስልጣን የመጡ ሲሆን፣ ደስታ ሌዳሞ ደግሞ ምክትል አፈ-ጉባኤ ሆነው ተሹመዋል። ሙፈሪያት ቀደም ሲል በተለያዩ ሚኒስቴር መስሪያ ቤቶች እና እንደ ህዝብ ተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አፈ-ጉባኤ በመስራት ያካበቱት ልምድ አላቸው።
oromo: Muferihat Kaamil waggoota shanan dhufaniif gadii fi olii mana maree federeeshinii akka geggeessituuf filatamteetti. Isheenis Ageenyahuu Teshagar bakka buutee kan aangoo qabatte yoo ta'u, Desta Ledaamoon immoo itti aantuu ishee ta'anii filatamaniiru. Muferihat kanaan dura ministeera gara garaa fi gadii fi olii mana maree bakka buutota uummataatti muuxannoo hogganummaa kan qabduudha.

title: Trump unveils 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee AI policy
english: President Donald Trump has established a new task force called the 'Super Intelligence Force' to manage and regulate artificial intelligence policies in the United States. Led by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton, this group aims to ensure American dominance in the field while coordinating with various public and private sectors. The initiative follows an executive order that officially rebranded artificial intelligence as 'Super Intelligence' to reflect its importance.

oromo: Pirezidaanti Donald Traamp biyya Ameerikaa keessatti imaammata 'artificial intelligence' to'achuuf 'Super Intelligence Force' kan jedhamu garee haaraa hundeesseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe pirezidaantichi 'artificial intelligence' jedhamu sun gara 'Super Intelligence'tti jijjiiramuu isaa erga ibsanii booda dha.

title: France closes up to 500 schools Monday over student protests
english: France is closing up to 500 schools this Monday due to safety concerns following violent student protests over education quality and facility conditions. Over the past week, demonstrations have spread across several major cities, resulting in property damage and injuries to both students and staff. The government is working to restore order while investigating reports that outside activists have infiltrated the student-led movement.

oromo: Faransaay rakkoo nageenyaa fi walitti bu'iinsa barattootaa wajjin walqabatee, manneen barnootaa 500 ta'an Wiixata cufuuf murteessiteetti. Hiriirichi gara jeequmsaatti jijjiiramuun qabeenya barbadeessuu fi miidhaa qaamaa hordofsiiseera; mootummaanis qaamoleen alaa hiriiricha keessa seenanii akka jeequmsa uuman dubbateera.

title: Djokovic defeats top seed Zverev to reach China Open semifinals
english: Novak Djokovic secured a spot in the China Open semifinals after a hard-fought comeback victory against top seed Alexander Zverev. Despite losing the first set and dealing with a brief dispute over court lighting, the Serbian star maintained his composure to win the next two sets. Djokovic will now advance to face Daniil Medvedev in the next round of the tournament.

title: Middle East oil exports surpass pre-war levels despite tensions, data shows
english: Despite ongoing regional conflicts and rising tensions, Middle East crude oil exports have recovered and climbed above pre-war averages toward the end of September. While official ship-tracking data indicates a surge in volume, Iranian officials have downplayed these figures and claimed to have forced US warships away from the region. The situation remains volatile, with reports of daily maritime attacks and Iranian threats to keep key shipping channels closed.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ግጭት እና አለመረጋጋት ቢኖርም፣ የጥሬ ዘይት ላኪነት መጠኑ ከመጋቢት 2025 እስከ የካቲት 2026 ከነበረው አማካኝ መጠን በላይ ማደጉን መረጃዎች ያሳያሉ። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ይህንን መረጃ በመቃወም የአሜሪካ የጦር መርከቦች ከቀጠናው መራቃቸውን እና የዘይት እንቅስቃሴውም እንደቀነሰ ይናገራሉ። ሆኖም በመርከቦች ላይ የሚደርሱ ጥቃቶች እና የኢራን የስትራት ኦፍ ሆርሙዝ መዝጊያ ዛቻ ቀጠናውን አደገኛ እና ያልተረጋጋ አድርጎታል።

title: Who were the top teen athletes at the Asian Games?
english: Teenage athletes made a significant impact at the recent Asian Games, with young swimmers leading their countries to historic victories. Nineteen-year-old Zhang Zhanshuo from China secured an impressive seven gold medals, while 13-year-old Yu Zidi earned MVP honors by setting multiple new records. Japanese athlete Shin Ohashi also stood out by becoming the first person to swim the 200m breaststroke in under two minutes and five seconds.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የእስያ ጨዋታዎች ላይ ታዳጊ አትሌቶች አስደናቂ አፈጻጸም በማሳየት ለሀገሮቻቸው ታሪካዊ ድሎችን አስመዝግበዋል። የ19 ዓመቱ የቻይናው ዣንግ ዣንሹኦ ሰባት የወርቅ ሜዳሊያዎችን ሲያሸንፍ፣ የ13 ዓመቷ ዩ ዚዲ በተለያዩ የውድድር ዘርፎች ክብረ ወሰኖችን በመስበር የውድድሩ ምርጥ አትሌት ተብላለች። እንዲሁም የጃፓኑ ሺን ኦሃሺ የ200 ሜትር የጡት ምት ዋና ውድድርን ከሁለት ደቂቃ ከአምስት ሰከንድ በታች በማጠናቀቅ አዲስ የዓለም ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግቧል።
oromo: Atileetonni dargaggoon tapha Eeshiyaa dhihoo kana gaggeeffame irratti raawwii dinqisiisaa agarsiisuun biyyoota isaanii injifannoo seena qabeessa gonfachiisaniiru. Zhang Zhanshuo kan Chaayinaa waggaa 19 ta’e medaalii warqee torba yoo galchu, Yu Zidi waggaa 13 ta’e immoo rekoodiiwwan hedduu cabsuudhaan atileetii hunda caalu jedhamee badhaafameera. title: Samoa PM apologises after Nazi salute video emerges
english: Samoa's Prime Minister, La’auli Leuatea Schmidt, has issued an apology after a 2007 video surfaced showing him performing a Nazi salute and shouting 'Heil Hitler' at a family event. The Prime Minister clarified that his past actions do not align with his current personal values or the stance of his government, firmly rejecting Nazism and extremism. Despite his strong support for Israel during his tenure, the resurfaced footage has drawn significant criticism from historians and academics.

oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Samoa La’auli Leuatea Schmidt, bara 2007 walga’ii maatii irratti mallattoo Naazii agarsiisanii fi 'Heil Hitler' jechuun isaanii viidiyoon ifa bahee booda dhiifama gaafataniiru. Mummichi Ministeerichaa gochi isaan darbe kun amantii isaanii fi ilaalcha mootummaa isaanii kan bakka bu’u miti jedhanii, Naaziizmii fi ධራ ጽንፈኝነት akka balaaleffatan ibsaniiru. Yeroo aangoo isaanii keessa Israa’eliif deggarsa guddaa kan qaban ta’us, viidiyoon kun hayyoota fi seenaa qorattoota biratti qeeqameera.

title: Bolsonaro beats expectations in Brazil vote, faces Lula in runoff
english: Brazil's presidential election will head to a runoff because neither candidate secured the required majority of the vote. Both Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and incumbent Jair Bolsonaro failed to reach the 50 percent threshold needed for an immediate victory. As a result, the two frontrunners will face each other again in a final round to determine the country's next leader.
amharic: የብራዚል የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ አሸናፊ ለመለየት ሁለተኛ ዙር ድምጽ መስጠት እንደሚያስፈልግ ተገለጸ። የሀገሪቱ ወቅታዊ ፕሬዚዳንት ጃየር ቦልሶናሮ እና ተቀናቃኛቸው ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ አንዳቸውም በምርጫው ለማሸነፍ የሚያስፈልገውን 50 በመቶ ድምጽ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። በመሆኑም አሸናፊውን ለመለየት ሁለቱ እጩዎች በሚቀጥለው ዙር ይወዳደራሉ።
oromo: Filannoon pirezidaantummaa biyya Brazil kanaan dura abdachiisirraa adda ta'ee, mo'ataa sirritti adda baasuuf gara marsaa lammaffaatti ce'eera. Pirezidaantiin amma aangoorra jiran Jaayir Bolsonaro fi morkataan isaanii Luwiiz Inaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa, nama tokkoon tokkoon isaanii mo'achuuf kan barbaachisu sagalee dhibbeentaa 50 guutuu hin dandeenye. Kanaafuu, hogganaa biyyattii itti aanu murteessuuf dorgommiin marsaa xumuraa akka gaggeeffamuuf jira.

title: Tigray’s Liberation Must End in Freedom
english: Tigrayan nationalism has successfully defended the region's survival through war, but it has failed to establish a lasting, citizen-led political order. The current crisis persists because leaders prioritize factional control over building inclusive institutions that function independently of military commanders. To move forward, the region must transition from mere liberation to the difficult task of creating a stable, law-bound government.
amharic: የትግራይ ብሄርተኝነት በጦርነት አማካኝነት የክልሉን ህልውና በማስጠበቅ ረገድ ስኬታማ ቢሆንም፣ ዘላቂ እና በህዝብ የሚመራ የፖለቲካ ስርዓት መመስረት አልቻለም። አሁን ያለው ቀውስ የሚቀጥለው መሪዎች የጋራ አስተዳደር ከመገንባት ይልቅ ለቡድን የበላይነት ቅድሚያ በመስጠታቸው ነው። ክልሉ ከነጻነት አውጪነት ወደ ዘላቂ፣ በህግ የሚመራ እና የተረጋጋ የፖለቲካ ስርዓት ግንባታ መሸጋገር አለበት።
oromo: Biyyummaan Tigraay waraanaan nageenya naannichaa kabachiisuu danda'us, sirna siyaasaa kan ummanni itti hirmaatu fi itti fufiinsa qabu diriirsuu hin dandeenye. Rakkoon yeroo ammaa jiru, gaggeessitoonni sirna waloo ijaaruu mannaa aangoo ofii jabeessuuf xiyyeeffannaa waan kennaniif kan dhufe dha. Kanaafuu, naannichi bilisummaa qofa irraa gara ijaarsa sirna siyaasaa tasgabbaa'aa fi seeraan bulanitti ce'uun isa barbaachisa.

title: Four African leaders issue joint declaration as Ethiopia war escalates
english: The leaders of Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia, and Sudan recently held a summit in Egypt to address rising regional tensions, including the civil war in Sudan and renewed fighting in Ethiopia. They released a joint statement advocating for peaceful dialogue while expressing opposition to Ethiopia's unilateral actions regarding Red Sea access and the Renaissance Dam. The declaration further emphasized that control of the Red Sea should be managed by coastal nations, signaling a clear disagreement with Ethiopia’s regional policies.

oromo: Hoggantoonni Gibxii, Eertiraa, Somaaliyaa fi Sudaan walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa kanneen akka waraana Sudaanii fi guddina waraana Itoophiyaa keessatti mul’atu irratti mari’achuuf Gibxii keessatti walgahaniiru. Hoggantoonni kunneen ibsa waloo baasaniin, rakkoolee nageenyaan hiikuun akka barbaachisu kan ibsan yoo ta’u, Itoophiyaan dhimma daangaa Galaana Diimaa fi hidha guddicha irratti tarkaanfii kophaa fudhattu mormaniiru. Ibsichi to’annoon Galaana Diimaa biyyoota daangaa qaban qofa jala turuu akka qabu dhaamsa dabarsuun, imaammata Itoophiyaa waliin walitti bu’iinsa qaban ifa godhaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Yemen fighting intensifies; Tehran says ready for US attacks
english: Yemeni government forces have launched a significant military offensive aimed at reclaiming lands currently occupied by the Houthi rebels. Meanwhile, Iran's Foreign Minister stated that while a military resolution to tensions with the United States is not viable, Tehran is prepared for a potential conflict. These developments highlight the escalating instability in the region as multiple factions engage in military movements.

oromo: Mootummaan Yemen, lafa yeroo ammaa kana harka warra Huutii jiru deebifachuuf duula waraanaa guddaa jalqabuu isaa beeksiseera. Gama biraatiin, ministirri dhimma alaa Iraan rakkoo Amerikaa waliin jiru waraanaan furuun akka hin danda'amne ibsuun, garuu biyyi isaanii waraanaaf qophii ta'uu ishee mirkaneessaniiru. Gochootni kunniin walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa keessatti mul'atu daran kan hammaatee deemu ta'uu agarsiisu.

title: Israel face spitting allegation as Ireland boss ‘delighted’ ties after over
english: Following a tense UEFA Nations League match between Ireland and Israel that ended in a 1-1 draw, an Irish coach has accused an Israeli player of spitting at him. The Irish manager expressed relief that the two-game series is over, noting the significant emotional and political strain the fixtures placed on his team. Football authorities are expected to launch a disciplinary investigation into the alleged incident.

Leenjisaan garee Ayirlaandi taphonni kun xumuramuu isaaniitti gammachuu ibsuun, dhiibbaa siyaasaa fi miiraa cimaa taphattootasaanii irra ture eeraniiru. Koreen angoon isaa adabbii fi qulqullinaa irratti hojjatu himata kana akka qoratu eegama.

title: Manchester City must be relegated, says Canada’s ex-Leeds manager
english: Former Leeds United manager Jesse Marsch has argued that Manchester City should face relegation due to severe financial rule violations spanning nine seasons. Marsch claims that the club's alleged manipulation of revenue and costs was an open secret within the Premier League, creating an unfair competitive landscape. While Manchester City denies these accusations and is currently appealing the ruling, Marsch insists that strict disciplinary action is necessary to maintain integrity in football.

oromo: Leenjisaan duraanii garee Liids Yuunayited Jeesii Maarsh, Maanchastar Siitiin seera faayinaansii liigichaa waggoota sagaliif waan cabseef gara liigii gad-aanaatti bu'uu qaba jedhaniiru. Maarsh akka jedhanitti, gareen kun galii fi baasii isaa garmalee guddisee ibsuun isaa durumaanuu namni hundi kan beeku ture, kunis dorgommii sirrii ta'e akka hin jiraanne taasiseera jedhan. Maanchastar Siitiin himannaa kana haaluun komii dhiyeessus, Maarsh garuu amanamummaa ispoortichaa eeguuf adabbiin cimaan murteessaa akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo can return to Portugal team if he wants, says Jesus
english: Portugal's head coach, Jorge Jesus, stated that Cristiano Ronaldo is welcome to return to the national team if he chooses to do so. This follows Ronaldo's sudden departure from the squad after being placed on the bench for a recent UEFA Nations League match. Jesus emphasized that the decision rests entirely with the 41-year-old star, who remains eligible for future selection.

oromo: Leenjisaan garee biyyaalessaa Poorchugaal Joorjee Jeesus akka jedhanitti, Kirstiyaanoo Roonaldon yoo fedhe gara garee biyyaalessaa isaa deebi'uu danda'a. Kun kan ta'e erga Roonaldon tapha 'UEFA Nations League' darbe irratti baankiirra taa'uun isaa erga isa aarse booda garee isaa gadhiisee deemuusaa hordofee dha. Leenjisaan kun murtoon kun guutummaatti kan Roonaldotti akka jiruufi gara fuulduraattis garee keessatti hammatamuuf carraan akka jiru ibsaniiru.

title: Election panel orders Netanyahu to remove 'election propaganda' videos
english: Israel's election oversight committee has commanded Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to delete online videos that improperly utilized state and military resources for political gain. The committee ruled that these clips functioned as campaign propaganda designed to influence voters by highlighting government accomplishments. Additionally, Netanyahu was fined approximately $9,500 to cover the legal costs incurred by those who challenged the videos.
amharic: የእስራኤል የምርጫ ኮሚቴ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የመንግስት እና የወታደራዊ ሀብቶችን ያለአግባብ ለፖለቲካ ቅስቀሳ የተጠቀሙባቸውን ቪዲዮዎች እንዲያስወግዱ ትዕዛዝ አስተላልፏል። ኮሚቴው እነዚህ ቪዲዮዎች መራጮችን ለመሳብ የተዘጋጁ የምርጫ ቅስቀሳዎች እንደሆኑ ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ለከሳሾቹ ወደ 9,500 የአሜሪካ ዶላር የሚጠጋ የህግ ወጪ እንዲከፍሉ ተወስኖባቸዋል።
oromo: Komishiniin filannoo Israa'el, Ministirri Muummee Beniyaamin Netaaniyaahuu qabeenya mootummaa fi waraanaa seeraan alaa fiixa baasuuf itti fayyadaman jedhamanii kanneen shakkaman viidiyoowwan intarneetii irraa akka haqu ajajeera. Komishinichi viidiyoowwan kunneen yaadannoo mootummaan hojjete ibsuun sagalee namaa argachuuf kan qophaa'an duula filannoo akka ta'an murteesseera. Kana malees, Netaaniyaahuun baasii seeraa kanneen isa himatanif gara doolaara Ameerikaa 9,500 kaffaluuf akka dirqaman murtaa'eera.

title: Israeli troops kill man in southern Syria
english: Israeli forces shot and killed a man in southern Syria early Monday, claiming he was attempting to approach a military site. This incident is part of ongoing Israeli operations in the region following the collapse of the Assad regime in late 2024. Israel maintains that these actions are necessary to ensure the safety of its troops and citizens.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ሰኞ ዕለት በደቡብ ሶሪያ አንድ ግለሰብ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ለመግባት ሞክሯል በሚል ተኩስ ከፍተው ገድለውታል። ይህ ድርጊት የአሳድ መንግስት በ2024 መጨረሻ ከወደቀ በኋላ በእስራኤል እየተካሄደ ካለው ቀጣይ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ አንዱ ነው። እስራኤል እነዚህን እርምጃዎች የወሰደችው የዜጎቿን እና የሠራዊቷን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እንደሆነ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el ganamuma Dilbataatti gara kibba Suuriyaatti namicha tokko bakka buufata waraanaa isaanii seenuuf yaalera jedhee ajjeeseera. Gochi kun mootummaan Assaad bara 2024 xumura irratti erga kufee booda tarkaanfiiwwan Israa'el naannichatti fudhatamaa jiran keessaa tokko dha. Israa'el tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte nageenya loltootaa fi lammiilee ishee eeguuf akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: Watch: Saudi air strike hits foam factory in Yemen’s Sanaa
english: A Saudi-led airstrike recently targeted a foam manufacturing facility located in Sanaa, the capital of Yemen currently controlled by Houthi forces. The attack resulted in a large fire at the site as residents and workers attempted to control the blaze. Yemen's government, which is supported by Saudi Arabia, confirmed conducting military operations against various Houthi positions throughout the country on Sunday.
amharic: በየመን ዋና ከተማ ሰንዓ፣ በሁቲ አማፂያን ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው የፎም ፋብሪካ ላይ በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የሚመራ የአየር ጥቃት ተፈጽሟል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ ፋብሪካው ተቀጣጥሎ በነበረው እሳት በመጋየቱ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እሳቱን ለማጥፋት ጥረት አድርገዋል። በሳዑዲ የሚደገፈው የየመን መንግሥት በበኩሉ፣ እሁድ ዕለት በተለያዩ የሀገሪቱ ክፍሎች በሁቲ ኢላማዎች ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ መውሰዱን አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Magaalaa guddittii Yaman, Sana'aa keessatti bakka Houthii to’annoo isaa jala jiru, warshaalee foomii irratti weerarri qilleensaa kan Saudii Arabaan durfamu raawwatameera. Weerara kanaan booda warshicha keessatti ibidda ka’een namoonni ibidda dhaamsuuf carraaqqii gochaa turan. Mootummaan Yaman kan Saudii Arabaan gargaaramu, guyyaa Dilbata darbe bakkeewwan Houthiin itti argaman irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuu isaa mirkaneesseera.

title: Polls close in Brazil as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remain neck and neck
english: Voting has concluded in Brazil's highly competitive presidential election, which features a close contest between incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. With over 150 million citizens eligible to participate, officials expect the electronic results to be processed and released quickly. If neither candidate secures an outright majority of more than 50%, a second round of voting will take place on October 25.
amharic: የብራዚል አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ድምፅ አሰጣጥ መጠናቀቁን ተከትሎ ወቅታዊው ፕሬዝዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና ተፎካካሪያቸው ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ እጅግ አጠራጣሪ እና የጠበበ ፉክክር እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። ከ150 ሚሊዮን በላይ ብራዚላውያን ድምፅ የመስጠት መብት ያላቸው ሲሆን፣ የኤሌክትሮኒክስ ድምፅ አሰጣጥ ስርዓቱ ውጤቱን በፍጥነት እንደሚያሳውቅ ይጠበቃል። ማንኛውም እጩ ከ50 በመቶ በላይ ድምፅ ማግኘት ካልቻለ፣ የሁለተኛ ዙር ምርጫ ጥቅምት 25 ቀን ይካሄዳል።
oromo: Filannoon biyya Brazil kan hanga ammaa itti fufaa ture xumurameera; kunis kan agarsiisu pirezidaantii amma aangoorra jiran Lula da Silva fi morkataa isaanii Flávio Bolsonaro gidduutti dorgommii cimaa jiraachuu dha. Namoonni miiliyoona 150 ol ta'an sagalee kennuuf mirga kan qaban yoo ta'u, bu'aan sagalee elektirooniksii battalumatti akka beekamu eegama. Yoo namni tokko sagalee kenne keessaa harka 50 ol argachuu baate, filannoon lammaffaan Onkololeessa 25tti kan geggeeffamu ta'a.

title: Cornell case puts New York’s progressive image at odds with its rape laws
english: A lawsuit filed by a Cornell University student alleging gang rape has sparked a major push to reform sexual assault laws in New York. Critics argue that despite the state's progressive reputation, legal loopholes like the 'voluntary intoxication' rule hinder survivors from getting justice. In response, New York officials have created a working group to review these statutes and propose changes during the upcoming legislative session.
amharic: በኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪ በቡድን ተደፈርኩ በሚል የቀረበው ክስ በኒውዮርክ የፆታ ጥቃት ህጎች ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ እንዲደረግ ግፊት ፈጥሯል። የኒውዮርክ ግዛት በሴቶች መብት ረገድ ግንባር ቀደም ነኝ ብትልም፣ አሁን ያሉት ህጎች ለተጎጂዎች ፍትህ ለማግኘት እንቅፋት እየሆኑ መሆኑ ይነገራል። ለዚህም ምላሽ ለመስጠት የኒውዮርክ ባለስልጣናት ነባር የፆታ ጥቃት ህጎችን ለመከለስ እና ማሻሻያ ለማቅረብ የስራ ቡድን አቋቁመዋል።
oromo: Barataan Yuunivarsitii Cornell tokko himata gudeeddii gareen raawwatame jedhee dhiyeesseen walqabatee, seeronni yakka saal-qunnamtii fiizii biyya New York akka fooyya'an dhiibbaan cimaan uumameera. Mootummaan New York mirga dubartootaatiin beekkamus, seeronni yeroo ammaa jiran namoota miidhaan irra gaheef mirga isaanii mirkaneessuuf rakkoo akka ta'an dubbatamaa jira. Haala kanaan, aanga'oonni New York seeronni kun akka sakatta'aman fi fooyya'iinsi barbaachisu akka godhamuuf garee hojii hundeessaniiru.

title: Ireland refuse handshake with Israel and don armbands in Nations League tie
english: During their UEFA Nations League match, the Republic of Ireland football team wore black armbands to honor Palestinians killed in Gaza. The Irish captain continued the team's protest by refusing to shake hands with the Israeli captain before kickoff. This match, which ended in a 1-1 draw, was moved to a neutral venue in Serbia due to public pressure regarding the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የአየርላንድ ብሄራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን በዩኤፋ ኔሽንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ወቅት በጋዛ ለተገደሉ ፍልስጤማውያን መታሰቢያ እንዲሆን ጥቁር ማሰሪያዎችን ለብሰዋል። የቡድኑ አምበል ከእስራኤል አቻው ጋር እጅ ከመጨባበጥ በመታቀብ ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። በሰርቢያ ገለልተኛ ሜዳ የተካሄደውና 1 ለ 1 በሆነ ውጤት የተጠናቀቀው ይህ ጨዋታ፣ ከእስራኤል-ፍልስጤም ግጭት ጋር በተያያዘ በህዝብ ግፊት ምክንያት ከዳብሊን ወደ ሌላ ቦታ እንዲዛወር ተደርጓል።
oromo: Taphattoota kubbaa miilaa biyya Ayirland tapha UEFA Nations League irratti, namoota Gaazaatti ajjeefamaniif yaadannoo ta'uuf harka isaanii irratti marsaa gurraacha hidhataniiru. Kabajni garee Ayirland durfataan isaa dura taa'aa garee Israa'el waliin harka wal qabachuu diduun mormii isaa ibseera. Taphi kun kan gaggeeffame biyya Serbiya keessatti bakka walaba ta'etti yoo ta'u, mormii waraana waldhabdee Israa'el fi Falasxiin irratti jiruun kan ka'e, taphichi magaalaa Dabliin keessaa gara iddoo biraatti akka jijjiiramu taasifameera.
